subject: How can I identify the original text file used to create a Distance Project?

messages.author: e53c8e38b16419a5
messages.subject: How can I identify the original text file used to create a Distance Project?
parts:
When you start the Data Import Wizard, Distance asks you to browse to the "File Containing Data to Import." You select a file, hit "OK" and continue on.

My question is: Is there a way to open a Distance Project and look up the name of the original text file that was imported via the Data Import Wizard to create that project?

Thank you,

Brigham

messages.author: 7482eee8d2863d12
messages.subject: Re: [distance-sampling] How can I identify the original text file used to create a Distance Project?
parts:
Hi Brigham, (cc list)

I can answer that one, since I wrote the wizard! No, I'm afraid the
import file name is not retained anywhere.

Cheers, Len
